Blessing of Scripture.description: Every consecrated harrier gains a +2 sacred bonus to Bluff, Listen, Sense Motive, Spot, and Survival checks while actively pursuing a target assigned by her church. When the designated target is a group, the bonus applies against the group's leader. The same bonus is also added to weapon damage rolls (including unarmed strikes) against the assigned target. At 5th level this bonus rises to +4, and at 10th level it increases to +6.

Crushing Despair.description: From 4th level onward, the consecrated harrier gains the ability to use crushing despair as a spell-like ability. The number of daily uses equals her Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1).

Detect Chaos.description: The consecrated harrier may use detect chaos at will, functioning as a cleric of her consecrated harrier level.

Dispel Magic.description: At 3rd level, the consecrated harrier can employ dispel magic as a spell-like ability. When making dispel checks with this ability, she may add her blessing of scripture bonus to the roll. Daily uses of this ability equal her Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1).

False Vision.description: Upon reaching 6th level, the consecrated harrier can use false vision as a spell-like ability. The effect must be centered on herself. She can use this ability a number of times per day equal to her Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1).

Faultless Hunt.description: At 10th level, a consecrated harrier who has an active implacable hunt may elevate it into a faultless hunt, which allows her to track her quarry even across different planes of existence. Unlike implacable hunt, which can track multiple individuals simultaneously, a faultless hunt can only be directed against a single individual at a time. To initiate a new faultless hunt, the consecrated harrier must first end any faultless hunt already in progress.

Implacable Hunt.description: Starting at 8th level, whenever the consecrated harrier inflicts a wound on a target who then escapes, she automatically knows the direction toward that target and the approximate distance (accurate to within 10% of the actual distance) separating them. If the target is within 50 feet, the harrier can determine the target's exact location. This ability functions only when the harrier and her target occupy the same plane of existence. Multiple targets can be tracked simultaneously through implacable hunt, provided each individual target belongs to a group that collectively constitutes the harrier's assigned mission target.

Sanctified Sight.description: Starting at 2nd level, the consecrated harrier gains a +4 bonus on all saving throws made against illusion effects.

Spells per Day.description: The consecrated harrier can cast a limited selection of divine spells. Casting a spell requires a Wisdom score of at least 10 + the spell's level, meaning a harrier with a Wisdom of 10 or lower cannot cast any spells. Bonus spells and saving throw DCs are based on Wisdom (DC equals 10 + spell level + Wisdom modifier). At levels where the harrier has 0 spells of a given level, she can only cast bonus spells granted by a sufficiently high Wisdom score. The consecrated harrier draws from the ranger spell list, supplemented by the following spells: 1st - animate rope, calm emotions, command, disguise self, doom; 2nd - charm person, daylight, detect thoughts, hold person; 3rd - clairaudience/clairvoyance, death ward, discern lies, see invisibility; 4th - dismissal, dominate person, legend lore, mark of justice.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency.description: The consecrated harrier does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.

classFeatures.description: Beginning at 8th level, if the consecrated harrier wounds a target and the target escapes, the consecrated harrier always knows the direction in which her target lies and the approximate distance (within 10% of the total distance) between her and her target. If the target is within 50 feet, the consecrated harrier can pinpoint the target's precise location. This ability only works if the consecrated harrier and her target are on the same plane of existence. Implacable hunt can be used simultaneously against different targets, as long as each of those individual targets is part of a group that is, in total, the harrier's target for her current mission.

classFeatures.description: At 10th level, a consecrated harrier who establishes an implacable hunt can intensify this to a_faultless hunt_, enabling her to locate her quarry even across planar boundaries. Unlike an implacable hunt, which can affect several individuals at the same time, only one faultless hunt against a single individual can be pursued at one time. For the consecrated harrier to begin a faultless hunt, she must abandon any faultless hunt that she is already conducting.

special: The candidate must accept an assignment from her church to locate and destroy some specific, individual enemy of the church. A character who fails must wait a year and a day before applying again. If she succeeds, the church accepts her as a consecrated harrier and she may gain levels in the class.
